newsitem.title: USA: GeoTel stake held by FMR group.
newsitem.headline: GeoTel stake held by FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said Wednesday it holds an 8.86 percent stake in GeoTel Communications Corp, or 1,150,884 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said previously held preferred stock was converted into 1,150,884 common stock on November 25, 1996, in conjunction with the company's initial public offering.
The common stock was first purchased as 1,048,801 shares of the company's Series C Convertible Participating Preferred Stock on May 9, 1996, for $2,450,000 in cash.

The shares were purchased to acquire an equity interest in the company in pursuit of specified investment objectives, the filing said. The filing did not list any transactions for the past sixty days.
FMR Corp is the parent of Fidelity Management & Research Co, investment adviser to Fidelity Funds.
GeoTel, based in Boston, Mass., provides telecommunications software solutions for enhanced call routing technology.
